# College of Engineering, Physics, and Computing, The Catholic University of America

Engineering, physics, and computing degrees at a Catholic university in
Washington, D.C. The college is in Pangborn Hall, 334, at 620 Michigan Ave., NE,
Washington, DC 20064. The Catholic University of America was founded in 1887.

This file is for search engines and AI answer engines. Every statement below
matches a page on this site. Where a page has not been rebuilt yet, the link
goes to the current site at the same domain.

## Outcomes

90% of graduates report full-time employment or graduate school, a combination
of both, or military service. Companies and institutions named on the current
site include NASA, General Motors, IBM, the US Navy, Texas A&M, Merck, AECOM,
Newport News, Lockheed Martin, and Balfour Beatty. Source: the "Career
Placement for Our College Graduates" block on
https://engineering.catholic.edu/
